title: Carve 0.2 inline delimiters
description: The delimiter kinds of the one delimiter stack: two bare, nine braced. Every closed span is a host for an attribute block. Sorted by name.

name.description: The identifier of the row, unique in its list.

node.description: The node type of the AST document.

html.description: The HTML element of the span.

clauses.description: The clause ids of the six 0.2 documents that the row encodes. The row is normative together with these clauses.

max_run.description: The longest run of the mark that is a delimiter. A longer run is text, each character of it.

before.description: A test on one neighbor character. A word character is a Unicode letter or number (general category L or N). Whitespace is a space, a tab or a line break, and the start and the end of the content count as whitespace.

after.description: A test on one neighbor character. A word character is a Unicode letter or number (general category L or N). Whitespace is a space, a tab or a line break, and the start and the end of the content count as whitespace.

can_open.description: The delimiter can open when both tests hold. Absent: no condition on the neighbors.

before.description: A test on one neighbor character. A word character is a Unicode letter or number (general category L or N). Whitespace is a space, a tab or a line break, and the start and the end of the content count as whitespace.

after.description: A test on one neighbor character. A word character is a Unicode letter or number (general category L or N). Whitespace is a space, a tab or a line break, and the start and the end of the content count as whitespace.

can_close.description: The delimiter can close when both tests hold. Absent: no condition on the neighbors.

text_when_followed_by.description: The mark is text when one of these follows it (C2-I-050). The clause applies to the mark of a braced opener too.

fails_when.description: Cases in which a paired span does not form (C2-I-053).

not_delimiters.description: Spellings the chapter names as text.

clauses.description: The clause ids of the six 0.2 documents that the row encodes. The row is normative together with these clauses.

chars.description: Characters. An entry is one character, or a range written as two characters joined by a hyphen, both ends included.
